description: This file defines the AttendanceService class, which provides methods to mark attendance, query attendance records, and generate attendance summaries. It interacts with a database layer and uses specific schemas for input and output data related to attendance management.

classes.name: AttendanceService
classes.description: Service class providing attendance management functionalities such as marking, querying, and summarizing attendance records.

methods.name: mark
methods.description: Creates or updates an attendance record for a student in a class on a specific day.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Retrieves attendance records based on provided filters such as class ID, student ID, and date range.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Generates a summary of attendance statuses for a specific class.
